blocks.text: Open-source product analytics with session replay and feature flags

PostHog combines the tools that product teams need into a single open-source platform: event analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B testing, and surveys. Instead of paying for five separate tools and dealing with data synchronization issues, everything lives in one place.

The self-hosting option makes PostHog unique among product analytics tools. Deploy on your own infrastructure and your user data never leaves your servers - a requirement for healthcare, finance, and other regulated industries. The open-source model also means no vendor lock-in.

For product-led growth teams, the combination of analytics and feature flags is powerful. Ship a feature behind a flag, gradually roll it out, measure its impact with built-in analytics, and make decisions with data - all within the same platform.
Event tracking, funnels, retention, and user paths
Watch real user sessions to understand behavior and find issues
Gradual rollouts, A/B testing, and targeting by user properties
Run experiments with statistical significance calculations
In-app surveys triggered by user behavior or properties
Deploy on your own infrastructure for complete data control
PostHog replaces multiple tools with a single platform. For product teams, having analytics, session replay, and feature flags in one place eliminates the data silos that plague multi-tool setups.
Our team can integrate PostHog into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
